## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Cloudflare) · $0.15/M input tokens · [developers.cloudflare.com](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-omni/)

<sub>[price source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-omni): Cloudflare Workers AI list price, observed 2026-10-31. USD per million input tokens, including tokenized media; no output-token charge. Not a fixed price per decision. · [context source](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/models/clef-omni): Cloudflare hosted endpoint limit, observed 2026-10-31. State, questions and tokenized media share the context window; this is not a local-memory guarantee.</sub>

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~86.6 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-omni/blob/f32dfc060386af3eadec676c64b34f24ece2bcde/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   pip install torch==2.11 transformers==5.10.2 huggingface-hub pillow av && python -c 'import sys; from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; p=snapshot_download("Cloudflare/clef-omni",revision="f32dfc060386af3eadec676c64b34f24ece2bcde"); sys.path.insert(0,p); from joint_schema_model import load_release_model,systemone; m,t=load_release_model(p,device="cuda"); print(systemone(m,t,{"model":"clef-omni","state":"The invoice is overdue.","questions":{"overdue":{"type":"noul","instructions":"Is the invoice overdue?"}}}))'
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Cloudflare](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-omni)
